questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

D _ _ K s _ u t K _ D u t _ s D u _ K s

options.text: d t D s K t
u s D S k t
u t D s K U
u t D s K t

questions.solution:
Checking options one by one:

1) D ***d t*** K s / ***D*** u t K ***s*** / D u t ***K*** s / D u ***t*** K s → doesn't follow any pattern

2) D ***u s*** K s / *D* u t K ***S*** / D u t ***k*** s / D u *t* K s → doesn't follow any pattern

3) D ***u** t* K s / *D* u t K *s* / D u t *K* s / D u ***U*** K s → doesn't follow any pattern

4) D ***u** t* K s / *D* u t K *s* / D u t *K* s / D u *t* K s → follows a pattern

Hence,** "u t D s K t"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some machines are equipment.

No machine is a radio.

All TV are radios.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some equipment are machines.

II. No TV is a machine.

III. Some radios are TV.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3195a858829f7aeaf0a8cc96030ac0d27b55f54d00ac26e8fb685ef69c10963.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some equipment are machines → True (As Some machines are equipment)

II. No TV is a machine → True (As No machine is a radio and All TV are radios)

III. Some radios are TV → True (As All TV are radios)

Hence, **"All of the conclusions follow".**

questions.question:
What will be the value of the given expression if 'A' means '+', 'B' means '-', 'C' means '×', 'D' means '÷'?

25 A 14 B (6 C 7) A (15 B 9) A (36 D 4) C 2
questions.solution:
Letters

 
 
 
A

 
 
 
B

 
 
 
C

 
 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

Given expression:

25 A 14 B (6 C 7) A (15 B 9) A (36 D 4) C 2

After replacing the letters with their meaning, we get the:

25 + 14 - **(6 × 7) **+ **(15 - 9)** + **(36 ÷ 4)** × 2

= 25 + 14 - 42 + 6 +** 9 × 2**

= **25 + 14** - 42 **+ 6 + 18**

= **63 - 42**

= 21

Hence, **"21" **is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

So, RESERVOIR is written as 9.

2) Number of letters in PRESERVING is 10.

So, PRESERVING is written as 10.

Similarly;

3) Number of letters in CONGRATULATION is 14.

So, CONGRATULATION is written as 14.

Hence, **"14" **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

9 : 504 :: 7 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is;

Let First Number = n

n × (n - 1) × (n - 2) = Second Number

9 × 8 × 7 = 504 

Similarly;

7 × 6 × 5 = 210

Hence, **"210"** is the correct answer.
